items.title: Rashee Rice: Will play this Sunday
items.text:
Rice (hamstring) will play in Sunday's game against the Broncos, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official website reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Aaron Jones: Cleared for Sunday
items.text:
Jones (knee) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Lions, Dane Mizutani of the St. Paul Pioneer Press reports.

items.title: Kenny Gainwell: Questionable for Week 8
items.text:
Gainwell (hip) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

items.title: Michael Wilson: Slated to play Sunday
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that Wilson (ribs) is expected to play Sunday at Dallas, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: Hopes to play Sunday night
items.text:
Barkley (hamstring/back) said Friday that he hopes to play in Sunday night's game against the Commanders, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.
